This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96652 - Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654,…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-110936 - Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102764 - BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2025-61624 - Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-21589 - Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-105134 - Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76519 - Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-105133 - Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-0322 - Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-104935 - Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-96951 - Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-5477 - ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2016-3081 - Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2023-22894 - Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2021-3199 - ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-3306 - ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88779 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102490 - Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102489 - Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-104286 - Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76504 - Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-86950 - Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88772 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88771 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-67279 - Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-65660 - Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-87902 - WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-5430 - WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-71362 - Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.
